sections.overview: This tropical barracuda occurs across the Indo-West Pacific, from the Red Sea and East Africa to the western Pacific.
sections.identification: It has an elongated, nearly cylindrical body and a greenish back over silvery sides; diagnostic details distinguish it from other barracudas.
sections.habitat: It is a marine, reef-associated fish found in shallow coastal waters, bays and estuaries; records extend to deeper water.
sections.diet: A Sri Lankan species account lists fishes and squid as food.
sections.behavior: The FAO catalogue notes catches by trawls and nets, but these records do not establish distinctive behaviour.
sections.reproduction: Species-specific spawning and early-life details were not provided in the accounts consulted.
sections.ecology: Its precise range is uncertain because it has been confused with the yellowtail barracuda, Sphyraena flavicauda.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern dated 2023.
